pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Echo distinguishes tap/hold Key3 for launcher/finisher. Vanguard uses Key3 for guard breaking; Exile combines left attack with Key3. Queen replays earlier damage on its next strike after Key3. The selected weapon’s actual result is checked.
